description: IndexMundi monthly commodity price table for one commodity (default gold), read from the public commodity page: month and price as IndexMundi publishes them. Prices are as shown on the page; units follow that page. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_bstock when you need B-Stock wholesale liquidation auctions: total live lots; finance_coingecko when you need CoinGecko spot prices for up to 10 coins in one currency. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

commodity.description: IndexMundi commodity slug, e.g. gold, crude-oil
